FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT aop.actual_order_id, aop.product_id
    FROM Actual_Order_Products aop
    JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON aop.actual_order_id = ao.actual_order_id
    JOIN Order_Deliveries od ON ao.actual_order_id = od.actual_order_id
    WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Success'
      AND od.delivery_status_code = 'Delivered'
      AND od.delivery_date >= '2018-03-01'
      AND od.delivery_date < '2018-04-01'
) AS uniq
JOIN Products p ON uniq.product_id = p.product_id;
